about: Rung 9's gate on replay (ladder.json rung 9; experiments.json E10), written before any scored run. score.py reads it. A slot is {value, status, proposed}: while any slot here or in decide's logged config is open, score.py refuses a scored run and gives the proposed values only with --plumbing, labelled not a score. Fill a slot by setting value and status 'set'; a filled gate gets a new id if it changes after a scored run.

comparator.kind: the frozen incumbent re-run beside the log (incumbent.py, den_lighting's policy.py unchanged)
comparator.scene: per bulb, the target den_lighting last acted on (a command, or a bulb it found already there), else the bulb's last recorded state
comparator.light_model: the model in decide's logged config, the same version for both arms

anticipation.definition: Per need episode (a track's PersonState from its first state that leaves none to its next none, when it reached engaged in between; onset-protocol: contact-starting), 1 when the arm makes a need-driven change within anticipation_window_s of the onset that raises the mean predicted light at the track's task points by at least anticipation_rise over its value just before the onset. A need-driven change is a decide decision whose rule turns the reading look on or off; every den_lighting change follows its mode, so the incumbent scores 0 by construction. The rate is the mean over episodes whose light is predictable (no unknown level).
anticipation.label: replay surrogate

floor.note: a floor on the candidate, not a difference: the incumbent scores 0

stability.definition: Per need episode, 1 when the arm makes no need-driven change after anticipation_window_s and before the episode ends that moves the mean predicted task light by more than stability_change of its value before the change. The incumbent scores 1 by construction.
stability.label: replay surrogate

floor.note: a floor on the candidate, not a difference: the incumbent scores 1

anticipation_window_s.note: need v0 reaches engaged 5 s or more after starting (den_lighting's dwell), and decide answers at engaged

anticipation_rise.note: relative rise of the mean predicted task light

stability_change.note: relative move of the mean predicted task light

compensation.note: the compensation option the scored log must have used (decisions.json compensation, pending). The register advises P1 in mode form for rung-9 replay, with P0 and P3 scored as counterfactual logs on the same evenings

fixed.decision_ms_note: A9: each decision under 100 ms, aims included (hue-den-4 has no aims)
fixed.service_note: owner choices 8 and 9: a mark is served at an instant when at least 70% of its points get the floor; coverage counts from the end of the quiet window

reported_not_gated.label: predicted, replay surrogate
reported_not_gated.needs: the owner's marks on gold-labelled replay sessions (score.py --marks) and a light model in lx; otherwise n/a

gate: pass when the log replays byte for byte, every decide decision re-plans in under decision_ms_max, every decide decision carries its requested and applied scenes and the recipients of its scene, its exclusions recompute from its own inputs, its hard_conflicts recompute from its scene (no free channel in them), and the candidate's anticipation and stability rates each reach their floor
